title: Unfolding a run at the first step
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The configuration reached after $t+1$ steps from $c$ equals the configuration reached after $t$ steps starting from the one-step successor of $c$.
replaced:
For every multi-tape Turing machine $M$, configuration $c$, and $t \in \mathbb{N}$,
running $M$ for $t + 1$ steps from $c$ equals running $M$ for $t$ steps from
the configuration obtained by one step of $M$ from $c$.
